scope: Mobile gallery-first low-fidelity screen inventory; design only
notes: This is a proposed screen map, not implemented application behavior.
All UI titles and labels use English to match the current app locale. purposeAr explains intent for review.
The four root destinations are Gallery, People, Discover and Studio.
backTo=origin restores the initiating screen, media ID, timestamp, selected detection, active sheet, filters and scroll position.
People and Characters are variants of one collection surface; photo/video results share one result viewer with appropriate controls.
Pose/outfit categories share one tabbed surface; matching results share one surface with pose, colour, body-area, group and saved-mark variants.
PC pairing is requested for compute actions; local browsing and stored review data remain available offline.
Photo-only group/equipment capabilities, optional body grouping and unsupported character identity sources remain explicit.
LoRA models, datasets, saved face identity sets, shared base engines and available DFM models are different entities.
Source-media/model/dataset provenance appears only when an explicit durable relationship is known; older unlinked records retain their available private snapshot.

Existing supported selection actions are retained; this inventory does not promise unrestricted file operations, semantic search, universal undo, arbitrary-step training resume or automatic garment-tag filters.
Artifact-aware deletion confirmation is a result-viewer state variant: list any same-ID dataset/model and files before confirming.

Implementation review: existing merge does not automatically preserve every LoRA/provenance link and can remove marks. Resolve this blocker before implementing the proposed safe merge flow; it is not product UI copy.
